source_system: 臺中市主要遊憩據點遊客行為資訊網
source_api_contract: anonymous internal website endpoints; not formally versioned

processing.winsorization: linear-interpolated p01/p99 over all 80 baseline rows, separately per metric
processing.scaling: fixed-baseline min-max to 0-100; clipped to 0-100; constant range maps to 50
processing.rank: descending TCDPI score; spot_code ascending deterministic tie-break

sensitivity_analysis.perturbation_rule: Each base weight is varied by ±0.10; the other two weights are proportionally rescaled to keep the sum at 1.

known_method_questions_for_agency: Visitor sample expansion and inclusion/exclusion rules

Exact revisit denominator and meaning of same period
Suppression, rounding, revision and backfill rules
WKT purpose, CRS and effective dates
